lines.text: At Antioch, the Holy Spirit tells the prophets and teachers to set apart Barnabas and Saul, and hands are laid on them.
Sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sail from Seleucia to Crete and preach in Salamis synagogues.
At Paphos, the proconsul Sergius Paulus summons Barnabas and Saul to hear God's word, but the sorcerer Elymas opposes them.
Filled with the Holy Spirit, Paul tells Elymas he will be blind forever, and darkness comes over him.
The proconsul sees what happened, believes, and is astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
